text:
mira: Quick heads-up — during the 00:00-01:00 UTC hourly rollup we detected ~0.6% missing heartbeat claims from a subset of HW partners, which led to entitlement fingeprint mismatches for affected accounts. Anyone seeing similar from the partner side? :thinking:

alex: Not on our side yet. Can you paste an example of the payload that failed validation?

mira: Yes — here's a redacted sample from the failed webhook we got: 
```json
{
  \"device_id\": \"dev-12345\",
  \"timestamp\": \"2026-03-22T00:15:12Z\",
  \"usage_minutes\": 12,
  \"fingerprint\": \"a1b2c3d4\"
}
```
The matcher rejected it because the partner heartbeat sequence was missing an expected seqno and our compact fingerprint diff didn't align.

jordan: Is this the same compact fingerprint that we compute as sha256(device_id + date + seqno)? Could drift be caused by timezone truncation?

mira: We're using canonical UTC for the fingerprint, yes. The mismatch looks like a missing seqno rather than tz truncation.

si_engineer: On the SI side I saw a handful of retries that never reached the ingestion endpoint due to a short-lived CDN 502. We logged the original ack but the replay window may have expired. Sending logs now.

patricia: Can we confirm the TTL/backfill policy? If replays fall outside the 1hr window we currently drop, partners will see entitlement gaps. We should decide if we extend backfill to 6h for this batch.

mira: Proposal: 1) Temporary backfill window to 6h for affected partner namespaces. 2) Run fingerprint reconciliation job that looks for missing seqnos and attempts idempotent crediting. 3) Add a lightweight verifier on ingestion that returns a compact diff with expected seqno so partners can self-heal.

alex: +1 to verifier. Implementation notes: we can return a 200 with body `{\"expected_seq\": 123, \"missing\": [122]}` so partner connectors can immediately replay missing messages.

marketplace-billing-bot: automated alert — 42 entitlements flagged as \"mismatch\" during hourly rollup. Playbook link: https://go.redwood/integrations/recon-playbook

jordan: For the reconciliation job, let's do an initial dry-run that emits candidate fixes to a table (no credits). If results look sane we can toggle to apply mode. Also add a checksum column of original payload to avoid double-apply.

si_engineer: I'll coordinate with the partner integration team to surface the verifier and to bump their replay TTL. ETA to ship verifier endpoint: 6 hours.

patricia: I'll draft a short partner notice explaining the temporary TTL extension and the verifier endpoint, and include sample curl for the debug flow.

mira: Great — action items: 
• si_engineer: expose verifier endpoint + logs (6h)
• alex/jordan: reconciliation dry-run (3h)
• patricia: partner comms draft (1h)
• ops: toggle backfill window for partner namespaces to 6h (requires approval)

mira: tagging @ops for approval. Also adding note: we should not change billing until reconciliation dry-run passes. :white_check_mark:
